predecessor.reuse: Market identities may be rediscovered from the same official endpoint. The one stored batch-history response and every market-trade probe are excluded from v2.

scope.hypothesis: Causal public Binance BTCUSDT spot and USD-M perpetual flow available during a Polymarket BTC five-minute event predicts the jointly verified official endpoint better than target-blind calendar and training-prevalence controls.
scope.independence: This is an independent Polymarket model-development lane. Binance is a public read-only exogenous data source only. Binance credentials, accounts, orders, balances, positions, capital, PnL, risk state, and execution authority are forbidden.

source_contract.binance_availability_rule: A completed second becomes available only at second_ms plus 1000 milliseconds.

target_contract.label: Up when official terminal CLOB and Gamma evidence both identify the Up token as the unique winner; Down when both identify Down.
target_contract.development_access: Train and tune targets may be collected only after all role feature rows and their dataset manifest are immutable.
target_contract.test_access: Test targets may be collected once only after an immutable pretest artifact binds the fitted model, scaling, calibration, action-free evaluation policy, dataset, implementation, and source commit.

binance_features: spot and perpetual signed aggressive quote share
spot and perpetual maximum aggregate quote
forbidden: Polymarket historical price or trade history

partition.insufficient_power: Reject or extend under a new preregistered contract. Never relax gates after test access.

candidate_contract.search: A fixed bounded regularization and tree-complexity grid only. No test-driven changes.
candidate_contract.calibration: Choose no calibration or tune-only logistic calibration using tune log loss before test access.
candidate_contract.ai: No language model is screened on this historical lane because reproducible point-in-time text inputs do not exist. AI remains veto-or-reduce only in the prospective lane.

resource_contract.network: Use bounded retries, Retry-After, request-size limits, cursor checkpoints, and no authenticated endpoint.
resource_contract.rate: At most five requests per second per public origin with no burst above five.
resource_contract.storage: Store canonical official identity and terminal payloads with hashes once, compact feature rows once, and never duplicate local Binance raw data.
resource_contract.memory: Stream one UTC day at a time; no full-history raw payload accumulation.
resource_contract.database: Use one compact DuckDB historical-screen database with separate feature and target schemas, explicit transactions, and durable phase transitions.
resource_contract.ssd: Do not retain downloaded Binance archives, Polymarket trade history, or failed price-history payloads.
